title: Creator space
about: Add your small video pieces. Pilotix mixes them to make lots of ads.
help: Each product has its own folder on your computer, with 3 small folders: hooks, corps and cta. You can also put videos in them yourself (with your file explorer), then come back here: they show up.
unsupported: For now, the Creator space works on a computer with Chrome or Edge.
unsupportedHelp: Open Pilotix in Chrome or Edge on your computer to add your videos.

intro.title: Where to keep your videos?
intro.text: Choose a folder on your computer. Your videos stay in it: nothing is sent to the internet.

reopenText: Your browser asks for your OK to open the folder “{{name}}” again.
folderTitle: Your videos' folder, on this computer
pickFail: Could not open this folder. Try another folder.
denied: The folder is not open: say yes in the browser's window.
lost: The folder is not there anymore (moved or deleted). Choose it again.
noProducts: First add a product in Products & stock.
private: Your videos stay on this computer.

hooks.title: Hooks
hooks.hint: What stops the thumb: a question, a problem, a reaction.

corps.title: Body
corps.hint: Show the product and what it does.

cta.title: CTA
cta.hint: Say what to do: order, price, delivery.

empty: No video yet. Click “+ Add” or drag your files here.
same_one: {{count}} video was already in the folder
same_other: {{count}} videos were already in the folder

del.title: Delete this piece?
del.text: The video “{{name}}” will be removed from the “{{folder}}” folder on your computer.
